#### Looking for a repeated entry

The algorithm `has_repeat` decides whether some value appears twice in an array `A[1..n]`, where $n \ge 1$,
by comparing every pair of positions:

```text
procedure has_repeat(A, n)   // A[1..n] is an array, n >= 1
    found := false
    for i := 1 to n - 1
        for j := i + 1 to n
            if A[i] = A[j]
                found := true
    return found
```

Run `has_repeat` on the array $A = (3, 1, 4, 1)$, with $n = 4$.
List the pairs $(i, j)$ that the inner loop compares, in order,
and give the first pair at which `found` becomes true.

:::
